billing_unit.name: AIC
billing_unit.note: GitHub AI Credit. All model usage is token-metered (input, cached input, output; Anthropic models also bill cache writes) and settled in AIC. Code completions and next-edit suggestions are not billed in AIC.

free.note: Small allowance that varies; see the plans page.

business.note: AIC pooled at the org level; per-seat allowance not fixed here.

enterprise.note: AIC pooled at the org level; per-seat allowance not fixed here.

plans_note: Individual paid plans = base credits matched 1:1 to the subscription price plus a flex allotment GitHub can rebalance as model economics change. Max = $200/mo = 20,000 AIC.

knobs.reasoning_efforts_note: Display-form ladder, ascending. Ground truth: the GPT-5.6 announcement (2026-07-18 capture) confirms the token ladder minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max ('max' is the new deepest — even more reasoning time than 'xhigh'); Copilot CLI's /model picker renders Title-Case display forms, of which 'Medium' and 'Extra High' were directly observed (2026-07-18 screenshots), mapping to medium and xhigh. The other four display renderings are Title-Case mappings of the confirmed token ladder, not yet observed in the picker — if the picker renders any differently, correct the list HERE (only here). Mechanism: reasoning effort is set INTERACTIVELY in the /model picker with the left/right arrow keys on the selected model row (picker footer: '←/→ reasoning effort'); it is a per-model property — rows showing '—' have no reasoning control (observed: Auto, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Kimi K2.7 Code), while every other observed row (GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash, MAI-Code-1-Flash, Claude Sonnet 5/4.6, Claude Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6 incl. fast mode, Claude Fable 5) defaults to 'Medium'; GPT-5.6 Sol was observed cycled up to 'Extra High'. A headless surface is UNCONFIRMED — no copilot -p flag or settings key for reasoning effort is known to exist; do not invent one. If one ships, record it here (only here).

long_context_note: GPT-5.6 long-context step-up rates on Copilot (GitHub Models and pricing doc, captured 2026-07-18), NOT modeled as long_context sub-objects on the GPT-5.6 rows in this kit — a deliberate scope fence; the pre-existing long_context sub-objects on other rows are unrelated and untouched. Single correctable point if ever modeled: GPT-5.6 Sol >272K input → $10.00/$1.00/$45.00; Terra >272K → $5.00/$0.50/$22.50; Luna >200K → $2.00/$0.20/$9.00 (input/cached-input/output per 1M tokens, USD).

claude-fable-5.notes: The standout model on this roster — the best available, and not close. Sole frontier tier. Reserve it for the hardest work: long-horizon agentic runs, large migrations, and problems a strong-tier model already failed on. Worth its AIC precisely when a strong-tier model would fail.

claude-opus-4.8.notes: Strongest non-Fable Anthropic model; the default strong-tier pick for multi-file features, hard debugging, architecture, and review.

claude-opus-4.7.notes: Same published rate as Opus 4.8; kept selectable because /model lists it. Prefer 4.8 for new work.

claude-opus-4.6.notes: Same published rate as Opus 4.8; kept selectable because /model lists it. Prefer 4.8 for new work.

claude-opus-4.5.notes: Same published rate as Opus 4.8; kept selectable because /model lists it. Prefer 4.8 for new work.

gpt-5.5.notes: OpenAI flagship (Powerful); step-up rates above 272K input tokens. Strong tier — Fable 5 is the sole frontier pick.

gpt-5.3-codex.notes: Coding-focused reasoning model; id doc-confirmed. Best value in the strong tier for code work.

gemini-3.1-pro.notes: Public preview; step-up rates above 200K input tokens.

claude-opus-4.8-fast.notes: Preview fast mode: Opus capability at Fable-level prices — you pay 2x for speed, not capability. Pick plain Opus 4.8 unless latency is the constraint.

promo.note: Promotional pricing; the post-promo rate is not yet published — re-check update_from after this date.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: The default mid-tier workhorse and best value on the roster at promo pricing: day-to-day coding, tests, docs, refactors.

claude-sonnet-4.6.notes: Same published rate as Sonnet 4.5. Superseded by promo-priced Sonnet 5 for new work.

claude-sonnet-4.5.notes: Same published rate as Sonnet 4.6. Superseded by promo-priced Sonnet 5 for new work.

gpt-5.4.notes: OpenAI workhorse; step-up rates above 272K input tokens.

gemini-3.5-flash.notes: Lightweight-class but priced above the cheap lane; routed as mid.

kimi-k2.7-code.notes: Budget coding model; mid capability at near-cheap prices.

claude-haiku-4.5.notes: id doc-confirmed. Cheapest Anthropic model; classification, extraction, formatting, bulk.

gpt-5-mini.notes: Cheapest input rate on the roster; lightweight lookups and bulk.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: OpenAI flagship durable tier (Powerful), GA. Rates captured 2026-07-18 from the /model picker's cost panel ('High cost' — Credits Per 1M Tokens: input 500, output 3,000, cache read 50, cache write 625; converted via billing_unit.usd_per_credit) and re-confirmed 2026-07-25 against the models-and-pricing doc, which adds the >272K long-context step-up recorded above. Caveat: that doc's OpenAI table carries NO cache-write column — the 6.25 above comes from the picker's cost panel only, and is the one figure here the doc does not corroborate. Reasoning adjustable in the picker (default Medium; observed up to Extra High). Picker shows 400K context, tab-toggled 1.1M — capability facts, not prices.

gpt-5.6-terra.notes: Balanced everyday tier (Versatile), GA; confirmed present in /model 2026-07-18. Rates confirmed from GitHub's Models and pricing doc (captured 2026-07-18; Copilot USD is API pass-through for GPT-5.6 — 250/25/1,500 credits per 1M tokens) and re-confirmed 2026-07-25, which adds the >272K long-context step-up recorded above. Cache writes bill at 1.25x uncached input per the doc (not stored per-model here). Reasoning adjustable in the picker (default Medium); 400K context per the picker.

gpt-5.6-luna.notes: Fast & affordable tier (Lightweight), GA; confirmed present in /model 2026-07-18. Rates confirmed from GitHub's Models and pricing doc (captured 2026-07-18; Copilot USD is API pass-through for GPT-5.6 — 100/10/600 credits per 1M tokens) and re-confirmed 2026-07-25, which adds the >200K long-context step-up recorded above — note the 200K threshold is LOWER than the 272K used by the other GPT-5.6 rows, so long-context rates kick in sooner here. Cache writes bill at 1.25x uncached input per the doc (not stored per-model here). Reasoning adjustable in the picker (default Medium); 328K context per the picker.

claude-opus-5.notes: Added 2026-07-25 from the models-and-pricing doc (GA, Powerful). Same published rates as Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7/4.8, so it is a strong-tier peer on price. NOT yet confirmed present in the /model picker — if the picker does not list it, remove it here (this file's roster rule is what /model actually offers).
